# Innovative Auto Sourcing

> Closed dealer-lane vehicle sourcing agency serving the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada.

## What We Do

Innovative Auto Sourcing (a registered trade name of Innovative Auto Sourcing Incorporated) is a
sourcing agent, not a retail dealer. We bid on a client's exact vehicle spec inside licensed
dealer-only wholesale auctions -- OPENLANE, Manheim, EBlock -- and hand over the vehicle at the
real auction hammer price plus a flat sourcing fee, with a fully itemized, open-book invoice.
OMVIC General Dealer registration is in progress; the company does not sell retail inventory.

## Pricing Model

- Refundable $500 intake deposit, fully applied toward the flat sourcing fee.
- Flat $1,500 CAD sourcing fee (no dealer lot markup, no hidden fees).
- $250 CAD DriveON digital safety inspection on every vehicle.
- Reconditioning billed strictly at cost: ~$1,000 (cars/light SUVs), ~$1,500 (trucks/vans), ~$2,000 (luxury).
- Client receives every auction invoice and repair receipt directly.

## Vehicle Categories

- Work trucks: Ford F-250/F-350 Super Duty, Chevrolet Silverado 2500/3500HD, Ram 2500/3500, 1-ton utility bodies.
- Cargo vans: Ford Transit (mid/high-roof), Ram ProMaster, Chevrolet Express 2500/3500.
- Executive and personal vehicles sourced on request.
- Optional extended warranty / protection plans (Powertrain, Commercial Diesel, Comprehensive).

## Service Area

Greater Toronto Area, including Toronto, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, and Oakville, Ontario, Canada.
